caseName: Grand Trunk Western Railroad v. Stephenson
caseNameFull: Grand Trunk Western Railroad Co. v. Stephenson, Administratrix
attorneys: Mr. Silas H. Strawn for petitioner., Mr. Ralph F. Potter for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit granted, limited to the question whether the District Court properly disposed of the causes in view of Illinois Revised Statutes 1937, Chapter 70, § 2.
